variables.input:
fetch dt.entity.host
| fields hostGroupName
| dedup hostGroupName

fetch dt.entity.host 
| filter in(hostGroupName, array($Host_Group)) 
| fields tags 
| expand tags 
|parse tags, """LD: category << ':' LD: value"""
| filter category = {variable_category} 
| fields value 
| dedup value 
| sort value asc

fetch dt.entity.host
| fieldsAdd hostGroupName, tags
| filter in (hostGroupName, array($Host_Group))
| filter in (tags, array($Tags))
| fields entity.name

fetch dt.entity.host
| filter in (entity.name, array($Host_Name))
| fields id

smartscapeNodes "SERVICE"
| fields id, name

| lookup [
  smartscapeEdges "*"
  | filter type == "runs_on"
  | filter in (toString(target_id), array($Host_ID))
  | fields source_id, target_id
], sourceField:id, lookupField:source_id

| filterOut isNull(lookup.source_id)
| fields id
